features.name: log_income
features.description: Log-transformed income to compress extreme tail and produce a smooth linear-friendly scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes heavy-tailed income for stable SVM margins.

features.name: log_count
features.description: Log-transformed transaction count to reduce skew.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooths transaction-count distribution for linear separability.

features.name: log_neighbors
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses degree skew for linear weighting.

features.name: log_weight
features.description: Symmetric log transform of weight handling extremely small values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tames extreme weight tail for stable linear coefficients.

features.name: looped_ratio
features.description: Fraction of looped transactions relative to total count, an interpretable circularity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded ratio is directly useful as a linear feature for behavioral signal.

features.name: income_per_count
features.description: Log of average income per transaction count, a per-event severity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Per-transaction income magnitude useful as linear severity feature.

features.name: neighbors_per_count
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures fan-out density used by SVM as smooth predictor.

features.name: day_of_year_sin
features.description: Sine-like cyclic encoding approximation of day-of-year via polynomial smoothing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Cyclic temporal projection helps linear separability across seasons.

features.name: day_of_year_cos
features.description: Cosine-like cyclic encoding approximation of day-of-year.
features.expected_model_benefit: Complements sine encoding for full cyclic representation.

features.name: length_norm
features.description: Length normalized to [0,1] using observed maximum (144).
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounded chain-length signal directly usable as linear coefficient.

features.name: activity_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of normalized activity signals (count, neighbors, looped) emphasizing overall transaction intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear composite aligns with SVM hyperplane orientation for activity-driven signals.

features.name: suspicious_pattern_score
features.description: Semantic judgment of suspicious transaction structure: high looped ratio combined with low neighbors and high income-per-count indicates self-cycling laundering-like behavior. Computed as a bounded smooth score combining these signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes domain heuristic about circular flow patterns as a smooth linear feature.
